title: Alexa Plus is getting an AI update to handle more complicated instructions

paragraphs.text: Amazon’s upgraded AI assistant will be able to do more across a wider range of smart home devices.
paragraphs.translation: 亞馬遜升級後的 AI 助手將能夠在更廣泛的智慧家居設備上執行更多操作。

paragraphs.text: Amazon is launching an update to its Alexa Plus assistant that will allow it to connect to smart home devices in new ways. With the update, which is currently in preview, Alexa Plus can link up with tech from Bosch, Delta, Ecovacs, iRobot, Yale Home, Whirlpool, Tapo, Eufy, and others, while automatically routing requests to the correct device.
paragraphs.translation: 亞馬遜正在為其 Alexa Plus 助手推出一項更新，使其能以全新方式連接智慧家居設備。這項更新目前處於預覽階段，Alexa Plus 可以與 Bosch、Delta、Ecovacs、iRobot、Yale Home、Whirlpool、Tapo、Eufy 等品牌技術連結，同時自動將請求發送到正確的設備。

paragraphs.text: In an example shared by Amazon, a person with a supported washing machine can say, “Alexa, my kid’s soccer jersey could use a deep clean, but the tag says cold wash only.” From there, Alexa Plus would navigate the washer’s cycle options and choose the correct setting. The new integrations are powered by Amazon’s new AI developer toolkit, which is supposed to make it easier for device makers to connect to Alexa Plus, “including those with unique capabilities that weren’t supported before.”
paragraphs.translation: 在亞馬遜分享的一個範例中，擁有受支援洗衣機的使用者可以說：「Alexa，我孩子的足球球衣需要強力清洗，但標籤上寫著只能冷水洗。」隨後，Alexa Plus 會操作洗衣機的循環選項並選擇正確的設定。這些新整合功能由亞馬遜新的 AI 開發者工具包驅動，旨在讓設備製造商更輕鬆地連接到 Alexa Plus，「包括那些以前不支援的獨特功能」。

paragraphs.text: Amazon widely launched its revamped AI assistant in February, which can handle multi-step requests and help you create routines using your voice. It currently only performs tasks in a limited number of third-party services, such as Ticketmaster, OpenTable, Uber, Thumbtack, Expedia, Yelp, Square, and Angi.
paragraphs.translation: 亞馬遜於二月廣泛推出了其改版後的 AI 助手，它可以處理多步驟請求並協助你用語音建立日常行程。目前它僅能在有限數量的第三方服務中執行任務，例如 Ticketmaster、OpenTable、Uber、Thumbtack、Expedia、Yelp、Square 和 Angi。

paragraphs.text: But Amazon is trying to change this by adopting the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open-source standard that allows AI models to connect to external systems and tools. This will give more brands the ability to interact with Alexa Plus, with Canva, Headspace, Priceline, Lyft, Cengage, Virgin Atlantic, Weekend, and other companies launching integrations later this year.
paragraphs.translation: 但亞馬遜正試圖透過採用模型上下文協議 (MCP) 來改變現狀，這是一項允許 AI 模型連接到外部系統和工具的開源標準。這將使更多品牌能夠與 Alexa Plus 互動，Canva、Headspace、Priceline、Lyft、Cengage、Virgin Atlantic、Weekend 等公司將於今年晚些時候推出整合功能。

paragraphs.text: For example, Priceline will give customers the ability to browse hotel options and book a trip directly through Alexa Plus. Priceline, along with Atom Tickets, Cengage, Fandango, and Taskrabbit, will soon support payments through Amazon Wallet as well.
paragraphs.translation: 例如，Priceline 將讓客戶能夠瀏覽飯店選項並直接透過 Alexa Plus 預訂行程。Priceline 以及 Atom Tickets、Cengage、Fandango 和 Taskrabbit 很快也將支援透過 Amazon Wallet 進行付款。
